Package org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.toast

Class CraftingJobToastHelpers

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integratedterminals.client.gui.toast.CraftingJobToastHelpers
public final class CraftingJobToastHelpers extends Object
Client-only helpers for showing CraftingJobToasts. The JVM verifier loads client-only classes when linking any class that refers to them, so this must stay separated from the common code that triggers these toasts, as that would crash dedicated servers.
